name: Hamiora Te Rauparaha
bio:
Hamiora, a proud Māori from Rotorua, found his passion for motorsport after a chance encounter helping a rally team repair their car during a local event. His natural aptitude for problem-solving and his meticulous attention to detail quickly made him an invaluable asset. He transitioned into test driving coordination, where he excels at balancing driver feedback with technical data to optimize car performance.

At RFK Racing, Hamiora is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to drivers and engineers alike. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute their best. His ambition lies in pushing the boundaries of vehicle performance through innovative testing strategies, always seeking that extra edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: A solidly built man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations during testing sessions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on starting each test day with a traditional Māori karakia (prayer) for good luck.
